newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones fell 1.12 points to 6,346.91. PLDT's ADR rose by $0 1/8 to $60 1/2.
* The peso closed on Monday at 26.261 to a U.S. dollar from 26.267
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,105.55, up 32.76 points.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was at 11.46875 pct from 11.0625 pct.

* The Inquirer said Merrill Lynch, the New York-based investment bank, has singled out the Philippines out of 18 emerging markets as the "leading candidate for a credit ratings upgrade on the basis of improving macroeconomic fundamentals and continued political stability."

* Malaya newspaper said Far East Bank and Trust Company posted total profits of 1.652 billion pesos for the first nine months of the year, up by 23.3 percent from the previous year's comparative total.
* Times Journal said Globe Telecom GMCR Inc is investing 1.72 billion pesos next year t0 develop a modern phone system in Mindanao, southern Philippines.
